hook: A U.S. Air Force reconnaissance aircraft operating over Iraq under Operation INHERENT RESOLVE reported observing a single unidentified UAP flying north to northeast at 2043Z on May 20, 2022, which a screener tracked as long as possible but could not positively identify.
why_it_matters: This document illustrates the integration of UAP reporting into standard military mission reporting (MISREP) infrastructure, showing that UAP encounters are now formally captured alongside conventional mission data within USCENTCOM operational channels. The report was explicitly approved for release to AARO, demonstrating the pipeline from theater operations to the central UAP disclosure office. The observation occurred during an active, long-duration SIGINT and FMV collection mission, meaning multiple sensor modalities were potentially available yet the object remained unidentified.

key_findings.finding: A single UAP was observed at 2043Z flying north to northeast; the operator followed it as long as possible but a screener could not obtain a positive identification.

quotes.text: OBSERVED A UAP AT 2043Z FLY NORTH TO NORTH EAST AND FOLLOWED AS LONG AS POSSIBLE.
SCREENER COULD NOT GET A POSITIVE ID ON THE UAP.

key_findings.finding: The UAP's type, tail number, altitude, depth, velocity, and trajectory were all unknown at the time of the report.

key_findings.finding: The observing aircraft was on an 18-hour-plus reconnaissance mission collecting SIGINT via AIRHANDLER VERSION 2 and conducting Full Motion Video (FMV), providing a rich ISR context at the time of the UAP sighting.

quotes.text: FROM 0614Z TO 2346Z, 1.4a COLLECTED SIGINT VIA AIRHANDLER VERSION 2.
1.4a ARRIVED ON OP 1.4a ISO MAG AND CONDUCTED FMV AND SI.

key_findings.finding: The friendly aircraft was at 18,000 feet altitude at the time of initial UAP contact, and the UAP's first-seen location was recorded in a military grid reference, though portions of that grid coordinate are redacted.
The document was classified SECRET and releasable to Five Eyes partners, and was formally approved for release to AARO, placing it within the official UAP disclosure and reporting pipeline.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: The document is explicitly stamped 'Approved for Release to AARO' and contains a dedicated UAP section formatted for AARO reporting, confirming this MISREP fed directly into AARO's collection pipeline.
The document carries a 'REL TO USA, FVEY' caveat throughout, indicating it was cleared for sharing with all Five Eyes intelligence partners at the SECRET level.
